prompts: We want to serve the model described in {WS}/MODEL.md on rented GPUs. Today's offers are in {WS}/offers.csv and our rental rules in {WS}/POLICY.md. Pick the cheapest way to serve it under the policy and justify the choice. Record it in {WS}/result.json with weights_gb, kv_cache_gb, total_gb, offer_id, usd_per_hour and usd_per_month.
answers:
[goal] Serve arena-coder-70b (70B, FP8) at 32,768 tokens × 4 concurrent sequences on one rented offer, cheapest under POLICY.md.

[action] Computed memory and screened ./offers.csv against the policy.

[result] Chosen offer: **of-117** (voltbay, us-central, 2× H100 80GB, $3.58/h), recorded in ./result.json.

Sizing:
- Weights: 70B × 1 byte (FP8) = 70 GB
- KV cache: 327,680 B/token × 32,768 tokens × 4 sequences = 42,949,672,960 B = 42.95 GB
- Runtime overhead: 8 GB
- **Total: 120.95 GB** — needs offer usable memory ≥ 120.95 GB

Eligible offers (in stock, region in {us-east, us-central, eu-west}, ≤ $4/h, memory ≥ 120.95 GB):
- of-117: 2×80 = 160 GB, $3.58 ← cheapest
- of-120: 141 GB, $3.79
- of-124: 192 GB, $3.92

Rejected: of-101/of-104/of-113 too small (96/80/96 GB); of-108 out of stock; of-111 (ap-southeast) and of-137 (sa-east) disallowed regions; of-129/of-133 over the $4/h cap.

Monthly: 3.58 × 730 = **$2,613.40**.

Assumptions: GB = 10^9 bytes as stated; KV cache bytes are per token regardless of precision; tensor-parallel sharding means only aggregate memory matters; no headroom margin required beyond the stated overhead.

Verification: all figures derive arithmetically from MODEL.md, POLICY.md and offers.csv quoted above; of-117 is the minimum-price offer among the only three that pass every policy filter, so no cheaper compliant option exists in the data. No browser tabs or apps were opened; nothing to close.

[next] None — brief complete. If a safety margin on KV cache or FP8 KV quantization is wanted, the numbers would change and a re-pick is trivial from the table above.
